subject: general
question: Which of the following temples was built by Raja Raja Chola?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Brihadisvara Temple.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Brihadishvara Temple** was built by **Tamil king Raja Raja Chola I **between **1003 and 1010 AD. **
 
• It is located on the South Bank of the** Cauvery river **in **Thanjavur, Tamil Nadu, India.**
 
• The temple is dedicated to** Lord Shiva. **
 
• It is also a part of the **UNESCO World Heritage Site. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Lingaraj Temple **- It is a Hindu temple dedicated to Shiva, located in **Bhubaneswar, Odisha**. It was built by King **Jajati Keshari **and completed by King **Lalatendu Keshari**.
 
• **Meenakshi Temple **- It is located in **Madurai**, Tamil Nadu. It was built by the Pandayan Emperor **Sadayavarman Kulasekaran I **(1190 CE–1205 CE).
 
• **Jagannath Temple**** - **It is located in **Puri, Odisha,** and was built by** ****Ananta Varman Chodaganga Deva**,** the first king of the Eastern Ganga dynasty.**
 
• **Raja Raja Chola I **was a Chola emperor who reigned from 985 CE to 1014 CE and was the most powerful king in the south at his time chiefly remembered for reinstating the Chola power and ensuring its supremacy in South India and the Indian Ocean.
